title: How to Create a Career Plan to Manage Your Career Shift
description:
In this @teal_hq class, we're going to talk about how to build your plan for managing your career shift. You can use it for other parts of your career, but really it's focused on putting some structure and rigor around planning, a career pivot, or a career shift. 

We’ll cover the following: 

1. Our approach and key terms.
2. Some of the things we think about in defining your shift, thinking about what kind of career pivot you’re doing, the magnitude of it, and determining your goals.
3. Setting a timeline to work within, and time-bound action items to help you achieve your goals.

00:00 | Introduction
00:45 | Our framework for fulfilling work 
05:07 | Some of the things we think about in "defining your shift"
08:07 | Goals help you: focus your efforts, keep you energized, and give you purpose
11:09 | What's holding your back? (Create a plan & create a schedule)
21:16 | Wrapping up & conclusion


For more on making a career pivot, watch the rest of the videos in this playlist.
